detail.body:
## Overview

Expand the KVCR key adapter API to separate framework and router key conversions. Update callers and stub unused methods. This change is independent of other vLLM PRs.

## Validation

CI and e2e tests pass.

AI-assisted implementation.
detail.title: [KV Offload] Adapt to the new KVCR key adapter API

files.patch:
@@ -10,7 +10,7 @@ fi
 
 # TODO: Use the PyPI wheel once it is published.
 uv pip install --system \
-    "kvcr @ git+https://github.com/ai-dynamo/kvcr.git@8c6fb79be4dfd9d7bb797c7dc4656790273bc786"
+    "kvcr @ git+https://github.com/ai-dynamo/kvcr.git@5ce23b1527725cf623a3fc7feb94dc6d3d5fafaa"
 
 # Keep only the NIXL wheel matching the CI image's CUDA runtime.
 NIXL_VERSION=$(uv pip show --system nixl | sed -n 's/^Version: //p')

@@ -372,11 +372,11 @@ def test_kvcr_tier_adapts_request_and_load(monkeypatch, backpressure):
     assert bindings is not None
     assert bindings.key_adapter is not None
     monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_KV_EVENTS_USE_INT_BLOCK_HASHES", "0")
-    decode = bindings.key_adapter.decode
+    encode_to_router = bindings.key_adapter.encode_to_router
     hash_123 = (123).to_bytes(8, "big")
-    assert decode(BlockKey(bytes(key))) == hash_123
-    assert decode(BlockKey(bytes(same_hash_other_group))) == hash_123
-    assert decode(BlockKey(bytes(other_key))) == (124).to_bytes(8, "big")
+    assert encode_to_router(BlockKey(bytes(key))) == hash_123
+    assert encode_to_router(BlockKey(bytes(same_hash_other_group))) == hash_123
+    assert encode_to_router(BlockKey(bytes(other_key))) == (124).to_bytes(8, "big")
 
     tier.submit_load(_job(7, ctx, key=key, chunk_id=2))
